entries.name: Castle Archer
entries.sighted: Perched where the arrow-loops face inward. Nobody has explained why they face inward.
entries.studied: It will not close. Break the line of sight and it repositions rather than draws. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The fletchings are cut from a banner. Whatever the banner said, it is on the ground now, in pieces, aimed at you.

entries.name: Castle Grunt
entries.sighted: Garrison issue, worn to the shape of the man inside it. It still stands the post it was given.
entries.studied: Three swings and a pause it never shortens. The pause is where the muster drill told it to breathe. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Forty-one names went on the roll. The roll was never amended, only recited more quietly.

entries.name: Castle Hound
entries.sighted: Still collared. The collar has a name plate and the plate has been filed blank.
entries.studied: It commits early and cannot correct. Step aside and it spends its whole run on the empty floor. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Kennel ledger, last entry: fed. No date. Whoever fed them last did not come back to write down when.

entries.name: Castle Shield-Bearer
entries.sighted: It leads with the wall, not the weapon. The wall is the weapon.
entries.studied: Nothing gets through the front. Poise breaks before plate does; make it swing and take the side. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The gate was to be held until the light returned. This one is still holding the part of the gate it was assigned.

entries.name: Cathedral Acolyte
entries.sighted: Vested and attentive, and attending to nothing.
entries.studied: It heals the others. It is always the first thing in the room to kill. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Ordained on the strength of a promise the Chapter had already broken by then.

entries.name: Cathedral Shade
entries.sighted: It has the vestments and not the body.
entries.studied: It is only solid on the strike. That is the window and there is no other. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Six from the nave, Odile says, and will not say why the number matters.

entries.name: Cathedral Warden
entries.sighted: It keeps the doors of a building that has no congregation.
entries.studied: It punishes the retreat, not the approach. Do not give it your back. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Wardens were laity. They were given the keys because the clergy had gone below.

entries.name: Crystal Bat
entries.sighted: It navigates by a light that is not there anymore.
entries.studied: It dives once, then hangs. Punish the hang, not the dive. Resists physical 15%.
entries.mastered: They roosted in the shaft while it was still open. They have not learned that it closed.

entries.name: Crystal Crawler
entries.sighted: Low, patient, and always between you and the way out.
entries.studied: It has no ranged answer at all. Space is the whole fight. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The crawlers keep to the cut faces. Whatever was cut out of the rock, they are still walking the edge of the hole.

entries.name: Crystal Golem
entries.sighted: Assembled out of the seam, or grown out of it. The distinction stopped mattering.
entries.studied: The overhead is slow and the slam is slower. It has no answer once you are behind the arm. Resists frost 60%, physical 25%.
entries.mastered: The seam it came out of runs down to the shaft. Everything in these caverns is pointed the same way.

entries.name: Crystal Guardian
entries.sighted: It stands at a door that is no longer in the wall.
entries.studied: It will not step off its ground. Bait the lunge, then take the ground it left. Resists arcane 40%, frost 35%, physical 20%.
entries.mastered: Posted by the Chapter to keep the curious out. It has kept out everything, including the Chapter.

entries.name: Crystal Shade
entries.sighted: It keeps the shape of a person and none of the weight.
entries.studied: It phases through the first hit of any chain. Land the second. Resists arcane 50%.
entries.mastered: The relighting took people. This is the outline that was left in the socket.

entries.name: Crystal Slime
entries.sighted: It has taken the colour of the wall it fed on.
entries.studied: Slow to start, slow to stop. Everything it does can be walked out of. Resists physical 10%.
entries.mastered: The caverns grew clear before the Chapter came. The colour in these came from somewhere.

entries.name: Crystal Spitter
entries.sighted: It shears a piece off itself to throw at you.
entries.studied: It cannot spit and move. Force it to move. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Each shard it throws is smaller than the last. It is spending itself, and it does not appear to mind.

entries.name: Crystal Wisp
entries.sighted: A light with nothing carrying it.
entries.studied: It drifts on a fixed circuit and will not leave it. Step off the circuit and it cannot follow. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The Chapter stored light. Some of the light did not stay stored.

entries.name: Frost Archer
entries.sighted: It shoots from the wall and does not come down off the wall.
entries.studied: Cover is the whole answer. It will not reposition until you are out of the lane. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Arrows were rationed at three per day. The count on the quiver is far below three.

entries.name: Frost Hound
entries.sighted: Thin. It has been thin for longer than a thing can be thin.
entries.studied: It circles left, always. The right flank is free. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: They were fed last from the officers' portion. That was the officers' last decision.

entries.name: Frost Knight
entries.sighted: Full harness, and the harness has not been off in a very long time.
entries.studied: It reads your commitment and answers it. Attack late, not first. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The fortress stood the winter it was told to stand. The order for the next winter never came.

entries.name: Frost Raider
entries.sighted: Not garrison. Whatever it was, it arrived from outside and stayed.
entries.studied: It opens aggressive and cannot sustain. Weather the first exchange. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The fortress let them in during the second winter. There is no record of a vote.

entries.name: Hollow Anchorite
entries.sighted: Walled in on purpose, once, by its own request.
entries.studied: It cannot leave its cell. Everything it has is thrown. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The cell was sealed from the inside. The seal is intact.

entries.name: Cairn Golem
entries.sighted: Stacked, not built. Somebody stacked it.
entries.studied: It sheds a course of stone each time it staggers, and moves faster with each one gone. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: A cairn is a marker. This one has been walking away from what it marks.

entries.name: Hollowed Bearer
entries.sighted: It is carrying something and will not be talked out of carrying it.
entries.studied: It defends the burden, not itself. Threaten the burden and it opens completely. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The bearers were sent up with the empty measures to be refilled. Nothing was ever sent down.

entries.name: Hollow Keener
entries.sighted: It makes a sound that is not for you.
entries.studied: The cry pulls others. Silence it first or fight the room it calls. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Mourning is the last practice the Hollow kept, and it kept it past the point of anyone to mourn.

entries.name: Frozen Pilgrim
entries.sighted: It is still walking the road, and the road is under the ice.
entries.studied: It will not deviate. Everything it does happens along one line. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: They set out for the light when the light was still a rumour worth walking to.

entries.name: Bellows Golem
entries.sighted: It breathes to keep a fire alight that went out a long time ago.
entries.studied: The exhale is the tell. Close inside the bellows-stroke and it cannot bring the arm around. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The forge it fed was to reheat the seals. The seals were never reopened, so it went on feeding nothing.

entries.name: Vault Foreman
entries.sighted: It still carries the tally board. The tally is complete and the work is not.
entries.studied: It calls the others in. Kill the call before the count, or the room fills. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The foreman's job was to certify that the measure was sealed correctly. It certified. It is still certifying.

entries.name: Needle Caster
entries.sighted: A caster built out of surplus. The surplus was people.
entries.studied: Long wind-up, straight line, no correction. Move once, at the end, and it wastes the whole charge. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The vault kept needles for suturing wounds and needles for sealing wax. These were reclassified.

entries.name: Ratchet Servitor
entries.sighted: It moves in notches and cannot go back a notch.
entries.studied: Predictable to the tooth. Count the notches and its next position is already yours. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Built to advance a mechanism nobody has found. Somewhere below, something is one notch further along.

entries.name: Vault Sentinel
entries.sighted: Vault-stock, stamped and issued, never once relieved.
entries.studied: It guards a line on the floor. Cross the line and it commits; stand on it and it will not. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Requisition: one sentinel, indefinite posting. Countersigned. The counter-signature is in the vault it is guarding.

entries.name: Depths Cantor
entries.sighted: It keeps time for a choir that is elsewhere.
entries.studied: The chant is a timer. Break it before the third beat or the room answers. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The Keeping had a liturgy because a liturgy is easier to repeat than a reason.

entries.name: Facet Golem
entries.sighted: Cut flat on every side, and none of the sides are its front.
entries.studied: It turns rather than steps. Circle faster than it turns and it never faces you at all. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Assembled out of the storage cells after the storage cells were emptied.

entries.name: Depths Lantern
entries.sighted: It carries a light and will not set it down.
entries.studied: It cannot attack while the lantern is raised. The raise is the whole opening. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Every lantern down here is full. That is what the Chapter promised, and it is the only promise it kept.

entries.name: Refractor
entries.sighted: It bends what it is hit with and gives some of it back.
entries.studied: Angle matters. Straight-on trades badly; from the flank it has nothing to bend. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Refraction was the Chapter's word for the process. The Chapter's word for the people was volunteers.

entries.name: Shardling
entries.sighted: Small, bright, and multiplying in a way that does not look like breeding.
entries.studied: Individually nothing. Never fight the third one; fight the room. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The Depths split the light to measure it. These are the offcuts of the measuring.

entries.name: Swamp Bogling
entries.sighted: It comes up out of the water without disturbing the water.
entries.studied: It only opens after it surfaces. Do not wait for it to surface. Resists poison 15%.
entries.mastered: The swamp took the low road out of the castle. Whatever came up the low road came up changed.

entries.name: Swamp Brute
entries.sighted: It has grown into the load it was made to carry.
entries.studied: Huge poise, terrible recovery. Everything after its swing belongs to you. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It carried the sealed measures down. It never carried anything back up.

entries.name: Swamp Hag
entries.sighted: She still keeps to a household routine that no longer has a household.
entries.studied: She hexes on a cycle, not on a read. Learn the cycle and the hex is free. Resists poison 70%, physical 15%.
entries.mastered: Nettle knew her name and will not say it, which is a kind of answer.

entries.name: Swamp Leech
entries.sighted: It attaches and then does the only thing it knows.
entries.studied: Detach it early or pay for it late. It does not release on its own. Resists poison 30%.
entries.mastered: The physicians used them, once, with intent. Then the physicians left and the intent stayed.

entries.name: Swamp Slasher
entries.sighted: Fast, thin, and cutting on the way past rather than at you.
entries.studied: It never stops on your side. Turn with the pass and it has spent its momentum. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It was tall once, and armoured, and is neither now. The reach is what it kept.

entries.name: Swamp Spitter
entries.sighted: It works at range because it cannot survive at close.
entries.studied: One step of pressure ends it. It has no melee at all. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The venom is a filtration product. Something upstream is being filtered.

entries.name: Swamp Swarm
entries.sighted: Many, and each one negligible, and that is the design.
entries.studied: Wide sweeps only. Single-target work loses the trade every time. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: They came up through the drains when the drains stopped being maintained.

entries.name: Swamp Toad
entries.sighted: It has been sitting there long enough to be mistaken for ground.
entries.studied: The tongue outranges the look of it by half again. Respect the reach or learn it. Resists poison 40%, physical 10%.
entries.mastered: Nothing in the swamp is native. Everything in the swamp arrived.

entries.name: Swamp Witch
entries.sighted: Robed, deliberate, and not surprised to see you.
entries.studied: The summon is the danger, not the caster. Close the distance before the second gesture. Resists poison 65%.
entries.mastered: The Chapter recruited from the fen because the fen already knew what the light cost.

entries.name: Chapel Censer
entries.sighted: It swings the censer on a chain long enough to be a weapon.
entries.studied: The chain has an arc and the arc has a centre. Stand in the centre. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The smoke was to carry the prayer up. The shaft goes down. Nobody corrected the rite.

entries.name: The Confessor
entries.sighted: It is waiting to be told something.
entries.studied: It punishes silence with a channelled attack. Interrupt or leave the range. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It heard the whole account and was not permitted to write any of it down.

entries.name: Cowled Thing
entries.sighted: Hooded, and the hood is not covering a face.
entries.studied: It fakes the first commitment every time. Never answer the first. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The Chapter's inner orders wore the cowl so that the outer orders would not have to recognise them afterwards.

entries.name: Chapel Penitent
entries.sighted: Kneeling, and it does not stop kneeling to fight you.
entries.studied: It cannot cover the low line. Everything below the waist is unanswered. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The penance was set at a term of years. The term has run and the sentence has not.

entries.name: Reliquary Golem
entries.sighted: It is built around a box and the box is what matters.
entries.studied: The reliquary is exposed on the turn. Hit the box, not the bearer. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: What was in the reliquary was a measure of daylight, sealed. Was.

entries.name: Bloat Brute
entries.sighted: Swollen past the point where the skin is doing anything.
entries.studied: It ruptures on death. Kill it somewhere you do not intend to stand. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The overflow had to go somewhere when the vaults were sealed. It went into things that were still alive.

entries.name: Mire Censer
entries.sighted: It carries the smoke rather than makes it.
entries.studied: Standing in the cloud is the mistake. It has no other plan and does not need one. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Censers were consecrated equipment. Somebody took them out of the chapel and put them to work.

entries.name: Mire Drifter
entries.sighted: It goes where the water goes and arrives without deciding to.
entries.studied: It does not track. Break line of drift and it keeps going past you. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Nettle counts drifters the way other people count debts.

entries.name: Mire Matron
entries.sighted: Larger than the rest and unhurried in a way that is worse.
entries.studied: It seeds the ground before it commits. Clear the ground or fight on its terms. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The mire produces these on a schedule. Somebody once knew the schedule and wrote it down.

entries.name: Reed Thresher
entries.sighted: It works the reeds flat in a wide arc and does not check what is in them.
entries.studied: The arc has an inside. Get inside it. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Built for harvest. There has been no harvest since the Keeping, and it has not stopped.

entries.name: Boss Castle Knight
entries.sighted: The one that was left to hold the hall.
entries.studied: It chains three and then over-extends on the fourth. The fourth is the whole fight. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It was given the hall and no instruction about when it might be relieved of it.

entries.name: Boss Cathedral Hollow
entries.sighted: Vested for an office that has no holder.
entries.studied: It empties and refills. The empty phase is when it can be hurt at all. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The office was Keeper of the Store. The store is not there.

entries.name: Boss Crystal Sovereign
entries.sighted: It grew a crown out of the same seam it grew out of.
entries.studied: It seeds the arena and then fights you inside its own garden. Deny the seeding. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The Chapter called this floor a reservoir. Something in the reservoir became a claimant.

entries.name: Boss Frost Warlord
entries.sighted: It took the fortress from inside and then defended it.
entries.studied: It hits harder as the floor freezes over. The floor is a clock. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The last order the garrison received was to admit it. The order is in the same hand as the muster roll.

entries.name: Boss Swamp Devourer
entries.sighted: It has taken in everything that came down the low road.
entries.studied: It telegraphs the swallow a full second early. Everything else is faster than it looks. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The overflow had to be put somewhere. This is where the Chapter put it.

entries.name: Forgotten Sovereign
entries.sighted: The Forgotten Sovereign, crowned for a succession that did not occur.
entries.studied: It fights in two halves and the second half discards the guard entirely. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The crown's inner band was never sized down. It was never worn by anyone it fit.

entries.name: Warden Of The Hollow
entries.sighted: The Warden of the Hollow, still making rounds.
entries.studied: It will not be baited off its circuit; the circuit narrows as it loses health. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It was set to watch the bearers come back up. It is still watching the stair.

entries.name: The Sealed Conclave
entries.sighted: The Sealed Conclave, in session, in perpetuity.
entries.studied: They act in sequence and the sequence never changes. Break the sequence by breaking the middle. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: They voted to seal the vault with the measure inside and themselves inside with it.

entries.name: Miniboss Castle Captain
entries.sighted: The rank is still legible on the shoulder.
entries.studied: It calls in support at half health. Do not be in the open when it does. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The captain countersigned the notice at the sallyport. Their signature is below the door.

entries.name: Miniboss Cathedral Bell
entries.sighted: The bell is the thing. What is under it is incidental.
entries.studied: The toll staggers you on a fixed interval. Everything must be spent between tolls. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It was rung to call the Chapter up. Nothing came up.

entries.name: Miniboss Crystal Guardian
entries.sighted: It is larger than the door it was posted to.
entries.studied: Its guard is total from the front and absent behind. The fight is a footwork problem. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Posted to keep the seam closed. The seam is open and it is still posted.

entries.name: The Choirmaster
entries.sighted: The Choirmaster, still keeping the measure.
entries.studied: It sets the tempo of the fight and punishes anything off the beat. Fight on its beat. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: It selected who would be relit and in what order. It kept the list. The list is the fight.

entries.name: Swamp Hydra
entries.sighted: More heads than the account allows for.
entries.studied: Heads act on separate timers. Fight the timers, not the heads. Resists poison 75%, physical 20%.
entries.mastered: It was one thing when it was sealed in. The sealing is the only date anyone recorded.

entries.name: The Hierarch
entries.sighted: The Hierarch. Every copy of the name was struck through, and the strokes are all in one hand.
entries.studied: It relights itself once. Everything before that is only the first half. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: The light was never stored. It was spent. The Hierarch signed for it, and the account has been balancing ever since.

entries.name: The Mireheart
entries.sighted: The Mireheart, and the mire drains toward it.
entries.studied: It draws the standing water in to heal. Fight it where the water has already gone. It shrugs off nothing in particular.
entries.mastered: Whatever was poured out of the vaults ran downhill for eleven years and arrived here.
